name: rava
description: Rava Productions reels. Approved look: E:\rava-edit\rava-reel-10 .. 12.
rules: Never place captions over the face; above or below it depending on framing.
The word 'Rava' stays white, never red.
Ending moves smoothly: no zoom pop on the CTA; masked-rise + red underline ending, no boxed caption.
No motion-graphic end card; cut from the closing line into the outro with a 0.25s crossfade.
No film grain. No dark glass panel cards at the top.
Graphics language: big kinetic words above the head, highlight bar behind a word, huge red/green italic serif, thin arrow-line labels, loupe zoom on real details.
Grade: bright mids and faces, clean deep blacks; never lift the black point. Light vignette only.
The CTA ('DM us now') lands last before the outro, even if spoken mid-take.
Deliver at portrait-4k with -q delivery; render one 4K job at a time.
Type (approved 2026-11-02): Montserrat 800 captions with word-by-word highlight and red accent words; Playfair Display italic for kinetic words.
